fields_available.note: The connector requests the 12 LONG ArcGIS field names below (never '*'); short shapefile/SODA names (HEIGHTROOF, GROUNDELEV, MPLUTO_BBL, ...) are REJECTED by the live service (returns HTTP 200 carrying an ArcGIS error object, code 400 'outFields parameter is invalid' - M5-T089 G1 finding F1). Field meanings are the City dictionary's; the SODA/ArcGIS metadata leave the height/BBL fields WITHOUT a description (M5-T087 section 2). Geometry esriGeometryPolygon; publication CRS wkid 102100/3857 (Web Mercator), but the connector requests outSR=2263 so every page must return wkid 102718 / latestWkid 2263 (EPSG:2263, NAD83 New York-Long Island, US survey feet) or it is refused before any coordinate is read. Coordinates are the service's reprojection of a Web-Mercator publication: DISPLAY/MASSING grade, not survey grade - MapPLUTO stays the measurement channel (M5-T087 section 3).

field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.OBJECTID: esriFieldTypeOID. 'Synthetic key populated by internal software.' NOT a stable per-building key - use DOITT_ID (dictionary).
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.DOITT_ID: esriFieldTypeInteger. 'Consistent unique identifier assigned by OTI (formerly DOITT).' The stable per-footprint identity (dictionary; BIN is NOT unique).
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.BIN: esriFieldTypeInteger. Building Identification Number; first digit = borough. 'Million BINs' (1000000, 2000000, ...) mark an unassigned/unknown BIN. Dictionary note: NOT unique (duplicated across split geometries).
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.BASE_BBL: esriFieldTypeString. 'Borough, block, and lot number for the tax lot that the footprint is physically located within.' Occasionally off-lot (agency sync) - surface disagreements, never silently trust. 10-digit digits-only.
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.MAPPLUTO_BBL: esriFieldTypeString. 'Borough, block, and lot number to be used for joining the building footprints to DCP's MapPLUTO data, which aggregates condominium buildings using DOF's billing BBL.' Non-condo: == BASE_BBL. Condo: the DOF billing BBL (lot 7501-7599), shared across multiple physical BASE_BBLs. The correct/only key to reach a condo's MapPLUTO geometry (M5-T087 section 5).
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.HEIGHT_ROOF: esriFieldTypeDouble. 'The height of the roof above the ground elevation, NOT height above sea level.' Zero or NULL means the information was not available - a typed gap, never a zero-height box (M5-T087 section 6 limit 1). Unit = feet (INFERENCE RQ-1, see open_questions).
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.GROUND_ELEVATION: esriFieldTypeInteger. City dictionary: 'Lowest Elevation at the building ground level. Calculated from LiDAR or photogrammetrically.' The service FGDC metadata instead defines it as a LiDAR bare-earth value interpolated at the building CENTROID. BOTH definitions stay DISCLOSED; the connector reconciles NEITHER. Datum NAVD88 'when collected photogrammetrically or from modern sources'; older/other-source datum unstated (RQ-2). A zero is kept as a real 0.0 flagged ground_elevation_zero_unverified, never guessed. Unit = feet (INFERENCE RQ-1).
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.CONSTRUCTION_YEAR: esriFieldTypeInteger. 'The year construction of the building was completed.' Zero/NULL => not available (typed gap; the connector nulls a zero year).
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.FEATURE_CODE: esriFieldTypeSmallInteger. Type of building. Documented domain: 1000 Parking, 1001 Gas Station Canopy, 1002 Storage Tank, 1003 Placeholder, 1004 Auxiliary Structure, 1005 Temporary Structure, 1006 Cantilevered Building, 2100 Building, 2110 Skybridge, 5100 Building Under Construction, 5110 Garage. Undocumented codes are flagged, never dropped.
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.GEOM_SOURCE: esriFieldTypeString. 'Photogrammetric' (stereo-compilation, most accurate, ~+/- 2 ft ASPRS) vs 'Other (Manual)' (less accurate). UNTRUSTED verbatim text - consumers must escape on render.
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.LAST_STATUS_TYPE: esriFieldTypeString. 'Feature last status type' (Demolition, Alteration, Geometry, Initialization, Correction, Marked for Construction, Marked For Demolition, Constructed). UNTRUSTED verbatim text - consumers must escape on render.
field_definitions_from_dictionary_M5_T08.deliberately_not_requested: NAME ('not actively maintained since original creation'); SHAPE_AREA / SHAPE_LENGTH / Shape__Area / Shape__Length ('Do not use' - auto-generated in Web Mercator, not area/length preserving); GLOBALID is ABSENT from this channel (RQ-6) - use DOITT_ID.

connector_implementation: IMPLEMENTED, UNWIRED. services/api/app/connectors/building_footprints_arcgis.py (SOURCE_ID self-declaration matches this record) + the extracted geometry helpers in services/api/app/connectors/building_footprints_geometry.py (M5-T101 PKT-C split). fetch_context_buildings queries footprints intersecting a validated EPSG:2263 envelope or closed polygon (esriSpatialRelIntersects, inSR/outSR=2263, LONG-name outFields allowlist, orderByFields=OBJECTID ASC + deterministic resultOffset paging honoring exceededTransferLimit with typed paging_pathology loop-safety); CRS-gates every non-empty page on wkid 102718 AND latestWkid 2263 BEFORE any coordinate is read; HTTP-200 ArcGIS-error-object trap; schema-drift/malformed/wrong-CRS/timeout/429/network all become a typed FootprintRefusal (never raises). Geometry policy (FOOTPRINT_GEOMETRY_POLICY): esri rings read verbatim, multipart/holes preserved, within/partial_overlap/boundary_touch/disjoint_locally classified (a party-wall touch is never an overlap), unusable geometry typed but the record never dropped. Typed gaps/flags (never defaults) for zero/NULL heights, null/zero ground, placeholder 1003, million-BINs, condo billing-lot joins, off-lot BASE_BBL. M5-T101 wiring-hardening riders: per-geometry vertex cap + cumulative decoded-bytes ceiling (typed resource_exhausted), optional wall-clock deadline + interactive fail-fast max_attempts (typed deadline_exceeded), correlation-id + log-field control-character stripping, ground-datum disclosure, untrusted-text field declaration. Recorded offline fixtures under services/api/tests/fixtures/building_footprints/ (byte-frozen, sha256-pinned); contract tests services/api/tests/connectors/test_building_footprints_arcgis.py. NOT in scope: route/scene wiring (PKT-E), the SODA channel connector, citywide bulk import.

known_limitations: HEIGHT_ROOF unit (US survey feet) is an INFERENCE (RQ-1): no per-field unit tag exists in the City dictionary or SODA metadata; the connector carries HEIGHT_UNIT_BASIS saying so. Do not treat as a tagged unit.

GROUND_ELEVATION has TWO conflicting official definitions (City dictionary lowest-ground vs FGDC centroid-interpolated bare-earth) and NAVD88 is stated only by the dictionary for modern/photogrammetric sources (RQ-2). Both stay disclosed; a massing consumer must choose the ground datum knowingly. A zero is a real 0.0 flagged unverified.
HEIGHT_ROOF 0 or NULL = 'not available': a typed gap, never a zero-height box.

Coordinates are a reprojection of a Web-Mercator publication (outSR=2263), so DISPLAY/MASSING grade, not survey grade; SHAPE_AREA/SHAPE_LENGTH are 'Do not use'; recompute area in EPSG:2263 if needed. Photogrammetric features ~+/- 2 ft; 'Other (Manual)' less accurate.
BIN is NOT unique (million-BINs + split-geometry duplication) - use DOITT_ID; BASE_BBL occasionally off-lot (agency sync).
Completeness threshold excludes buildings <400 sq ft or <12 ft tall - the footprint set is not every physical structure.
maxRecordCount=2000 rules this out as a citywide bulk mirror; per-lot/per-area queries only (thin client).
GEOM_SOURCE, LAST_STATUS_TYPE and the verbatim attributes dict are UNTRUSTED source text - consumers must escape on render (escaping is a render concern, PKT-E/PKT-I).
